server.instructions: Crow Memory — he pūmahara synaptic ā-waho mō ngā kaihāpai waehere AI. Ka tiakina tō āhua tuhi waehere, ōu whakaaro mō ngā hapa, me ōu hiahia hoahoanga hei matrices taumaha kōmitimiti i roto i te kōnae crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: He wāhanga bias Crow Memory ka whakaurua aunoatia. Kei roto tō āhua tuhi waehere, ōu hiahia, me ngā ture kua whanaketia. Me uta te kaihautū i tēnei i te tīmatanga o te wātū.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: Ka tiki i tō āhua tuhi waehere, ōu whakaaro mō ngā hapa, ōu hiahia hoahoanga, tō horopaki whaiaro rānei mai i te pūmahara synaptic a Crow. Karangahia tēnei i mua i ia whakautu kia hāngai ai ki te inductive bias o te kaiwhakamahi. Mā te taunoa (register=all, kāore rānei i tohua, domain=all), ka uiui i ngā register e 8 katoa, ā, ka hanumi i ngā hua puta noa i runga i te ōritenga whai hua.

parameters.query: He whakaahuatanga mā te reo Māori mō te mahi o nāianei.
parameters.register: Ko tēhea register. Whakamahia te 'all' (ka waiho rānei) hei uiui i ngā register katoa o te domain kua tīpakohia. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: He tātari domain ka whakamahia ina 'all' te register, kāore rānei i tohua. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = ngā register e 8 katoa (taunoa).
parameters.format: Te hōputu putanga. Ka whakahokia e 'hint' he tohu JSON (taunoa); ka whakahokia e 'bias_block' te wāhanga tuhinga [User Bias] hei whakauru ki te system prompt.
parameters.project: He tohu kaupapa ka whakamahia hei whakapiki i ngā tohu o te kaupapa kotahi, ā, hei tātari, hei whakawhiu rānei i ngā tohu o ētahi atu kaupapa.
parameters.strict_project: Ina true, ka tino tangohia ngā tohu o ētahi atu kaupapa i ngā hua.

crow_ingest.description: Ka whakauru i tētahi wheako tuhi waehere ki te pūmahara synaptic wā-roa a Crow. Karangahia i muri i ngā hua build, test rānei, i ngā urupare mārama rānei a te kaiwhakamahi. Homai he polarity mārama, he exit_code build rānei mō te maherenga aunoa o te polarity. Ka whakapaipaitia te ihirangi i te tuatahi; ka whakakahoretia te urunga haruru noa me te kore e pā ki te pūmahara.

parameters.key: He whakaahuatanga waitara mō te āhuatanga.
parameters.value: Te tauira waehere, te whakataunga rānei i whakamahia.
parameters.polarity: Te kaha whakaū [-2.0, 2.0]. Ehara i te here mēnā ka hoatu te exit_code; ki te hoatu ngā mea e rua, ka toa te polarity mārama.
parameters.exit_code: Te exit code o te build (0 = angitu). Ka maherengia aunoatia ki te polarity (+1.5/+0.5 mēnā ka angitu, -0.5/-1.0 mēnā ka rahua) ki te kore e hoatu he polarity mārama.
parameters.user_edited: I whakatikahia rānei e te kaiwhakamahi te putanga a te AI. Ka whakahāngaitia te polarity i ahu mai i te exit_code.
parameters.project: He tohu kaupapa ka tiakina me te urunga pūmahara mō te recall mōhiotanga-kaupapa ā muri ake.

crow_admin.description: Ngā mahi whakahaere a Crow i roto i te taputapu kotahi. Action: diagnostics (tatauranga pūmahara), drift (aroaro drift), prompt (pānui, tāpiri, tatauranga o system_prompt.md), backup (hanga, hurihuri, rārangi, whakaora), evolve (tāpae whakarerekētanga prompt), project_info (rārangi, hanga rānei i ngā instance kaupapa).

parameters.action: Ko tēhea mahi whakahaere: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, project_info rānei.
parameters.args: He ahanoa arguments motuhake mō te action, ka tukuna atu ki te mahi kua tīpakohia.

errors.project_name_required: Me whai project_name mō te action create

recall_messages.faint_bias: Ka mahara noa a Crow ki tētahi bias {register} āhua ngoikore. He ruarua noa ngā pūmahara kua tiakina.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: Kāore anō kia kitea he tauira whai pānga ā-tatauranga.

drift_messages.healthy: Kei te pai te māia o te pūmahara.
drift_messages.confused: Te āhua nei kei te raruraru te pūmahara a Crow. Tērā pea he hou rawa ngā mahi o nāianei, kua kī rānei te pūmahara. Whakaarohia te spectral reset, te archiving rānei.

system_prompt.header: # Crow Memory — Ngā ture system prompt
system_prompt.subtitle:
> Nā Crow ēnei ture i whakawhanake, ā, i whakaae te kaiwhakamahi.
> Ka whakaatu rātou i ngā bias tuhi waehere whai pānga ā-tatauranga.
> Kaua e whakatika ā-ringa, whakamahia ngā taputapu evolve o Crow MCP.
system_prompt.managed_by: <!-- Ka whakahaeretia tēnei kōnae e crow_mcp_server.py -->
default_rules: RULE: I mua i ia whakautu, karangahia a crow_recall(domain="all") hei uiui i ngā register e 8 katoa (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) mō te āhua tuhi waehere o te kaiwhakamahi, ōna whakaaro mō ngā hapa, ōna hiahia hoahoanga, tōna reka whaiaro, tōna whakaaro nui me tōna horopaki o nāianei. Whakaaturia ngā tohu i hokia mai ki tāu whakautu.

RULE: I muri i ia whakautu, whakaurua ngā mea i whākina e te kaiwhakamahi, arā ngā hiahia, ngā whakaaro, ngā whakatikatika me te horopaki, mā crow_ingest. Māu anō e whakatau te register me te polarity e tika ana, kaua e tatari kia kī mai te kaiwhakamahi "maumahara ki tēnei". I muri i te mahi waehere, arotakengia aunoatia ngā hua build mā crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Kaua e peke i ngā ture recall+ingest ahakoa mō ngā mahi ehara i te tuhi waehere, pērā i te whakatika tuhinga, ngā mahi git, te whakarerekē tautuhinga rānei. Whakahaeretia i ngā wā katoa.
